note: Front garden of the family house on moving day (outdoors, in front of the porch). Feminine left (girl passing the ball to the dog, girl with a model villa and a calf, priest blessing the lady's property, demure lady by her grand stone house, workman installing the porch lamp, ribbon-dancing girl, bee hotel, coat rack by the garden shack, bicycle rental with a padlock, two flatmates sharing one bench and one tiny door), the tenant (locataire, either gender) at the right; masculine right (man washing the outside of the window, boy's lemonade stand, seal with a domino by its doghouse, lawyer taking the rent, removal men carrying a wardrobe to the van, red toy sports car at the little stone porch, hedgehog in its log cabin). The porch's green front door leads into the vestibule; the gravel path at the bottom leads back to the street. Only lemonade, nobody drinks alcohol.
